headline: On November 11, 2006: PlayStation 3 launches in Japan
captionCards: Defined the seventh generation of video game consoles
instagramCaption:
PlayStation 3 hits stores in Japan on November 11, 2006.

The new console debuted as Sony's successor to the PlayStation 2.
It launched in North America on November 17 and in Europe/Australasia on March 23, 2007.
Its first release was in Japan, where it competed with Xbox 360 and Wii.

The PS3 helped define the seventh generation of gaming consoles.
